models.meaning: Ymir is the first giant, from whom the world was made. Models are what everything else is built on.

models.runeName: Uruz, the rune of raw strength

computers.meaning: Bifrost is the rainbow bridge between worlds. It connects your computers.
computers.story: Bifröst is the burning rainbow bridge between Midgard, the world of people, and Asgard, home of the gods. Heimdall keeps watch at its end.
computers.runeName: Raidho, the rune of the journey

connect.meaning: Valgrind is the gate of Valhalla. An API key decides who may come in.

settings.meaning: Forseti settles every matter fairly. Settings are the rules Yggdrasil keeps.
settings.story: Forseti, son of Baldr, sits in Glitnir, a hall with pillars of gold and a roof of silver. Everyone who brings a dispute to him leaves reconciled.
